description: Knowledge about space, planets, stars, galaxies, and the universe.

topics.name: Space Fundamentals
knowledge: Astronomy is the study of objects and events beyond Earth.
The universe contains galaxies, stars, planets, and many other objects.
Space science uses physics and mathematics to understand the cosmos.

topics.name: Stars
knowledge: Stars are massive objects that produce energy through nuclear fusion.
The Sun is the closest star to Earth and provides energy for life.
Stars change throughout their lifetimes depending on their mass.

topics.name: Planets
knowledge: Planets orbit stars and can have different compositions and environments.
Earth is a planet with conditions that support known life.
Planetary science studies the formation and evolution of worlds.

topics.name: Galaxies and Universe
knowledge: Galaxies contain billions of stars, gas, dust, and other objects.
The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System.
Cosmology studies the origin and evolution of the universe.

topics.name: Space Technology
knowledge: Space technology includes rockets, satellites, spacecraft, and telescopes.
Satellites support communication, navigation, weather monitoring, and research.
Space exploration expands scientific knowledge about the universe.
